hook.name: LiquidityMigrator
hook.description: Uniswap v4 graduation hook and permanent LP locker for a token launchpad. Uses `beforeInitialize` to gate pool creation exclusively to this contract, preventing anyone from creating a bonding-curve token's pool before graduation. Graduated positions are locked with no mechanism to remove liquidity; LP fees are split between the token creator and protocol treasury according to configurable fee parameters from the bonding curve manager.
